nom: PEACH & LILY Retinal For All Renewing Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum does not dry out or flake their skin the way other retinoids or tretinoin did for them, waking up with skin that still feels hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some managing rosacea, eczema, or a known reaction to other retinoids like Differin, overwhelmingly report no irritation and good tolerance; a couple describe a brief adjustment period of localized sensitivity that settled within days.
segments.combination: The few reviewers with combination, acne-prone skin report visible improvement in texture, discoloration, and fine lines without irritation.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who states her age, 49, reports her skin looking noticeably better within three weeks, with no issue from the product's yellow tint despite having fair skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers broadly report smoother texture, fewer visible fine lines, and reduced forehead and '11' lines within weeks to a couple of months of regular use, with a few also noting firmer, plumper-looking skin. A handful of reviewers, mostly early in use, report only minor or as-yet-unconfirmed changes and note results take patience.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers broadly report the serum keeps skin hydrated and avoids the dryness or flaking they experienced with other retinoids or tretinoin; one reviewer notes mild flaking if she uses it more often than the recommended weekly schedule.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including many who describe their skin as sensitive, rosacea-prone, or reactive to other retinoids, report no burning, stinging, or irritation. A minority report mild irritation on first use or a brief period of localized sensitivity that resolved with continued use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of dark spots, melasma, hyperpigmentation, or lip pigmentation with regular use, in some cases combined with other targeted treatments like vitamin C.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with hormonal, cystic, or general acne-prone skin report calmer skin, fewer or faster-healing breakouts, and reduced blackheads. A couple note the serum has not fully cleared their acne, and one describes mild purging when starting.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a yellow tint or residue
Pump can be hard to fully empty

extraits.texte: I have quite a few favorite P&L products and I wanted to love this one so bad but it turns your skin yellow. No matter how much you rub it in, the egg yolk yellow doesn't go away. Even after washing my face the next morning my skin still looks yellow. It also stains fabric

I have severe hormonal, acne, and my skin is extremely sensitive. I tend to research products at length before purchasing them. I've been using this product along with the Dermalogica vitamin c moisturizer and a Beautystat cleanser. I have noticed a vast difference in my skin in the last two weeks. While my acne hasn't cleared completely, I've noticed a significant reduction in the amount of acne, as well less inflammation overall.

extraits.titre: I was worried this would irritate my skin
extraits.texte: I have rosacea and eczema AND allergies, and so I tend to be very cautious about trying more than just the most basic skincare items. However, I've had good experiences with other Peach and Lily products, and this was more reasonably-priced than many options my dermatologist had suggested. Since it's marketed for sensitive skin, I decided to give it a shot.I saw improvements immediately. And even more impressively, I didn't have a bad reaction! My forehead creases are drastically reduced, and my skin tone and texture are steadily improving. I started with once a week, and am now at twice a week.
Love this retinol! I have super sensitive and dry skin and this formula does not dry out my skin or cause irritation. I have noticed an improvement with my skin texture, fine lines, and acne.
I have combination skin that is acne-prone. In my skincare routine, this one product has made the single greatest effect to skin texture, discoloration, and fine lines.

I have tried a lot of other PL products and generally like most of them but never enough to actually write a review. This is the only retinoid I can use, and it really works. I even had to go off prescription Tret bc my skin could never get used to it. I use Retinal for All every day with no problem and my 49yo skin is looking amazing after just 3 weeks. I have fair skin, and no problem with the yellow color. I use one pump for my entire face and neck and the color completely dissipates. Also, like another review stated, there is no "straw" connected to the pump inside the bottle but that's bc it doesn't need one. When you first get it, just keep pumping, it takes a while at first.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product myself
extraits.texte: Received several of these as samples. Decided to give it a try since I had enough to do a month or more of use. I am so glad I did. First product that has made a noticeable difference in my melasma and I have bought all the expensive brands!
